items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Who came to the jam sessions? Everybody, King Cole. Everybody that was out there at that time. --- ... Vincent Minelli, Jack Benny ---

ctx.x: ...I'm quite sure they could have gotten somebody else, there's no gettin' around that... But I think I got an A for effort 'cause I tried. We used to be workin' at a place anywhere and during the intermission they would be looking for me, and I'd be downstairs in the dressing room struggling with the guitar. That's where they had to come get me. That's how bad I wanted to try to keep up. I called myself the low man on the Tatum pole. I tried. I was trying... But some smart all sky agent convinced him he could…

Streets of Paris... we stayed out there the longest time. Then somehow or other we got a call to go to New York. We went to this place called the 3 Deuces. And we stayed there a long, long time. And then we went out, Cleveland, Chicago, we went everywhere. We were in demand. Didn't have the right agent.
